name: multi-git-promo
description: Multi-Git's second promo film (90 s master plus cutdowns), built with Remotion.

scripts.render: node audio/synth.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --color-space=bt709
scripts.render:prores: node audio/synth.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo-master-prores.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq --audio-codec=pcm-16
scripts.render:30: node audio/synth.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Promo30 out/promo-30s.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --color-space=bt709
scripts.render:vertical: node audio/synth.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Vertical out/promo-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --color-space=bt709
